name: torchroll
description: TorchRoll: a playable late-night torch-ballad keyboard for your MIDI keys. Slow triplet roll engine (rolled chords, triplet arps, grace leans, tempo-locked tremolo) over breath pad, upright-style bass and brushes on YOUR BPM/key/chords. DAW-grid WAV + MIDI export.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html app.js styles.css dist/
